steps.name: Set schedule
steps.do: Open **Set Wild Encounter schedule**. Choose an encounter, set times, and include today in the date range. Submit.
steps.expect: Success that the schedule was saved.

steps.name: Map verify
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Wild Encounters**, then open the encounter / meeting-spot marker.
steps.expect: Meeting spot / encounter marker is visible; tooltip/banner shows the scheduled times.

steps.name: Itinerary selector
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Edit Itinerary** / **Build Itinerary**, set the visit date to today, and open the **Wild Encounters** step.
steps.expect: The encounter is listed with the scheduled times.

steps.name: Cancel occurrence
steps.do: Open **Cancel Wild Encounter occurrence**. Choose the encounter from step 1, set **Date** to today, select a scheduled time, and submit.
steps.expect: Success that the occurrence was cancelled.

steps.name: Cancelled occurrence absent
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Wild Encounters**, then open the encounter marker. On **Itinerary**, open the **Wild Encounters** step for today.
steps.expect: The cancelled time is absent from the map tooltip/banner and from the Wild Encounters offerings.

steps.name: End schedule
steps.do: Open **End Wild Encounter schedule** and end the schedule from step 1.
steps.expect: Success that the schedule was ended.

steps.name: Future clear
steps.do: On **Map**, set **Specific Map** to a future date that was only covered by the ended schedule. In **Filter:**, enable **Wild Encounters**. On **Itinerary**, open the **Wild Encounters** step for that same future visit date.
steps.expect: The encounter is absent on the map and in Wild Encounters offerings for that future date.
